Soda Machine - Custom Image Formats (EAU, SODA, BEER)
====================================================

Repository: https://github.com/SnegOwo/Soda-Machine

Custom image compression formats written in Python:
- EAU  : lossless (horizontal delta + LZMA)
- SODA : lossy (quantization + LZMA)
- BEER : lossy WebP-style (YCbCr 4:2:0 + 8x8 DCT + LZMA)

This folder contains the pre-compiled Windows executable:
  Soda_Machine_Premium.exe

Run the executable to open the graphical viewer (eau_viewer).
Source code, build instructions and license are in the repository above.

License: MIT
